import { renderHTML as commitLinkHTML } from './components/FooterCommitLink.svelte.html.js';
/** Only this component's fixed SSR root is private; native callers receive one anchor. */
export function renderFooterCommitLink(full, short) {
  const raw = commitLinkHTML({ full, short });
  const open = '<!--[-->', close = '<!--]-->';
  if (!raw.startsWith(open + '<a href="https://github.com/elkimek/get-based/commit/')
    || !raw.endsWith('</a>' + close))
    throw new Error('Unexpected footer commit SSR envelope');
  const html = raw.slice(open.length, -close.length);
  if (html.includes('<!--'))
    throw new Error('Unexpected footer commit compiler comment');
  return html;
}
